A mixed meal with rice-and-meat portions, roasted potatoes, green pepper pieces, and what appears to be a small pizza or topped flatbread slice. Identification of the rice-and-meat portions is uncertain.

### 2 — Vessel

**Area = 3.14 × 12.5² ≈ 491 cm².**

### 3 — Items

- Roasted potato chunks, visibly seasoned and lightly oily
